warnings: F-Zero Forever 2.x is a separate package. Keep its runtime and profile outside your existing Portcove installation.

steps.title: Use a separate reviewed Windows v1.8.3 copy
steps.instruction: If you already have FZeroSNESRecomp-1.8.3-windows-x64.zip from the linked publisher release, extract the whole ZIP outside your Portcove library. Use a short, writable path with basic Latin characters. Open FZeroSNESRecomp.exe and select your own unmodified, headerless F-Zero (USA) .sfc file.

steps.title: Add the reviewed F-Zero copy to Portcove
steps.instruction: After the v1.8.3 game accepts your original, choose Use an existing installation. Select FZeroSNESRecomp.exe and its containing folder. Play is separate from registration. Keep the already reviewed external copy, original and data under your control. Removing the registration leaves the external files in place.

references.title: Keep your saves and settings
references.instruction: Keep the original game file separately. Preserve saves/ and config.ini, fzero-video.ini, keybinds.ini and rom.cfg beside the executable when moving your external Windows copy.

managed_acquisition_hold.reason: The current F-Zero Forever packages have a different launcher and bundled course data. Portcove is checking a compatible replacement. You can keep using your existing installation or prepare a separate reviewed v1.8.3 copy.
managed_acquisition_hold.activation_reason: This staged F-Zero SNES package does not match the reviewed Windows v1.8.3 release. Keep your current installed copy.

presentation.manual_preparation: Provide your own F-Zero (USA) .sfc or .smc file, with or without a copier header. Existing managed Windows v1.8.3 installations keep their saves and settings separately from external copies. Fresh managed acquisition is paused while the successor package is reviewed. This package enables BS Deluxe changes by default. Other mods, MSU music, developer tracing and capture setups are outside this reviewed route. Windows gameplay remains untested. This Windows build needs a short installation folder using basic Latin characters; original game files can stay in their existing location.

decisions.rationale: The former path returns HTTP 301 to numeric repository ID 1348026644, which is the repository identity the reviewed v1.8.3 release pin already binds, and the current RetroPortingToolKit path resolves to that same identity. The reviewed release 393440319 and Windows asset 580473673 keep their identities, size and SHA-256 at the new path. Every commit reachable from the repository's published branches and tags records the same author email, including the v1.8.3 release commit and the earliest recorded merge from a RetroPortingToolKit branch on 2026-10-30.
